stimulus.description: Discover the synthetic Claude-only catalog under a configured client key; repeat with an OpenAI-shaped models caller and a Claude-shaped caller.
Buffered native Messages to an explicit loopback custom upstream. Record beta query, credential header choice and cache/body transformations; do not rewrite the historical expectation.
Buffered downstream Chat with a real synthetic Claude SSE upstream; compare translated content, tools and usage. Historical buffered-upstream fixture remains distinct and blocked.
Return the exact synthetic count from the native count endpoint; do not substitute the generation endpoint or a local length estimate.

At clock 2000ms, send eight concurrent ingress requests with expiry 1000ms. Separately inject shared 401 refresh, token-endpoint 401 and 429; restart without reseeding. Source proves per-auth locking/reuse after a failed access token, not the stronger universal expiry guarantee.
Use the exact historical weather call/result history. Add two parallel calls and fragmented argument SSE, then send their correlated results through actual Messages ingress.

Native OAuth Messages with thinking budget 1024 and max_tokens 2048. Replay client-supplied opaque signature in the next turn and separately try omitted thinking history; do not attribute API-key-compatible automatic replay to OAuth.
Send text/image/text native content using the historical synthetic PNG. Compare base64 bytes, MIME and ordering; instrument any attempted remote fetch separately.

Send each historical malformed-base64/unknown-binary form independently. Count upstream sends and preserve CPA behavior even if it forwards or omits a part. No source-backed promise of native pre-I/O 4xx has been established.

Buffered downstream Responses backed by synthetic upstream SSE with response.completed. Observe forced upstream stream and previous_response_id removal. Transparent native-lite streaming, compatibility hydration, and continuation/validated-receipt qualification are independent axes; none proves the others.

Retain historical ordered SSE checks and separately probe sparse item.done then completed.output=[]. Executor native fidelity is source-only: its HTTP/WS axis is upstream transport, not downstream route. The assembled HTTP SSE framer backfills empty output even for Codex clients; desired transparent terminal delivery is a blocking product difference, not a supported CPA pass. Do not manufacture created/added/identity or infer receipt/history/cursor authority.

Synthetic compact result with encrypted content, then reuse that opaque result as input. Independently attempt stream=true and require the reference compact streaming error; never merge this with Responses-lite.

Retain historical authenticated downstream upgrade, ordered frames and actual close checks. Separately source downstream forwarder wire preservation from lite predicate AND selected auth provider codex, reset/recomputed on each selection. Internal completedOutput is restored independently, even when wire stays sparse. Executor source matrix referenced below is not a downstream WS gateway-chain test. Plugin/native selection and the full chain remain blocked; no receipt/history/cursor authority.
Run the same buffered Responses request through the native Codex alias and preserve raw differences from /v1/responses; an alias 404 cannot satisfy this row.

Run terminal completion, upstream truncation, explicit cancellation and downstream disconnect independently. Observe lease/socket cleanup and attempts after the first payload; also apply the historical WS lifecycle steps where required.

Two accounts and two client keys use the same session label concurrently; revoke A, exercise A/B again, restart independently without reseeding. Matching upstream auth/origin/proxy is only one part of the full isolation contract.
Synthetic usage_limit_reached with resets_in_seconds=2, and separately resets_at=1002 at clock 1000000ms. Exercise before/at reset, eligible B failover, restart, and a 429 after stream delivery.
Configure a named OpenAI-compatible Kimi backend with API key and explicit loopback URL. Observe that exact executor/provider and Bearer auth; it must not satisfy native Kimi OAuth coverage.

Native Kimi OAuth Responses against a loopback coding base. Put conflicting synthetic access tokens in metadata and API-key attributes; verify selected metadata token and native URL. Normalization at the historical pin must not include later tool-output reordering.
xAI API-key Chat is translated through the xAI Responses executor. Record using_api selection, translated native envelope and selected upstream credential; do not substitute generic Chat forwarding.

Grok Build OAuth defaults using_api=false. Observe dedicated CLI chat-proxy selection separately from explicit loopback origin overrides; compare ordinary HTTP previous_response_id deletion, not compact or WS behavior.
Enroll only synthetic provider credentials in a private state dir, send Messages, stop the process, then start an independent process using existing state without reseeding.
Use historical synthetic PKCE/state exchange endpoints only, then ingress Chat and fresh-process permanent-token restoration. Record JSON code/verifier exchange, not a rotating OAuth refresh grant.
Manually import the historical synthetic permanent token, once without and once with its devin-session-token$ prefix. Exercise Messages and restart without any code/token exchange.

Chat to real synthetic binary Connect/protobuf upstream with Basic token-token header and token-bearing metadata. Compare base64 wire observations only for synthetic provenance; H1 does not qualify H2.
Messages to the same synthetic Connect backend, preserving protocol-specific conversion and raw upstream binary bytes. It cannot borrow Chat-only adapter evidence.
Buffered Responses to synthetic Connect frames and EOS trailer. Preserve client output/usage and selected backend; do not admit WS or compact from this result.
Convert historical synthetic binary Connect frames to ordered Responses SSE under one-byte and uneven segmentation. Verify EOS-backed one terminal and incremental client delivery.

Use historical synthetic weather function_call/result pair, then parallel calls with fragmented argument deltas. Check matched ToolCallID/source=4; separately preserve CPA orphan-result downgrade rather than assert impossible strict identity.

Use historical thinking/model effort fixture; replay sealed.v1 and tagged Claude/GPT signatures separately. Observe byte/type transformation and UID selection, not blanket identical string preservation for every encoding.

Run historical inline image and unsupported audio/remote-image parts independently. Observe CPA omission versus required explicit MIMIC rejection as a strict difference, never equivalence or a waived row.

Provider-scoped synthetic embedded catalog and effort/UID mapping. Pin catalog provenance and observe no live updater traffic; source catalog fallback alone does not prove safe startup/background disable.

Count synthetic ping plus UTF-8 test symbol from the historical fixture. Compute floor(len(executor payload bytes)/4), not caller JSON characters or an exact tokenizer; require zero native count RPCs.

Inject Connect error trailer, partial five-byte header, truncated payload, clean EOF without EOS, downstream disconnect and cancel-after-delta. Preserve failure events and observe cleanup/no post-delivery redispatch.

Two permanent-token accounts reuse the same explicit session label, restart without reseeding and revoke A. Compare upstream session/cascade values and client-account boundaries; UUID normalization alone is not account scoping.

Observe synthetic unary GetUserStatus enrichment, quota/reset metadata, subsequent actual ingress Chat and restart. The permanent token must remain unchanged; no rotating OAuth refresh grant is fabricated.

HTTP 429 with Retry-After: 2 and separately an HTTP date; eligible B handles pre-delivery retry. Probe just before/at reset and restart, then fault after stream delivery and compare selected-account/session isolation.
